items.markdown:
For professional microneedling, treatments are typically done **every 4 to 6 weeks**.[[1]](https://www.threeriversdermpgh.com/blog/1373536-microneedling-frequency-how-often-should-you-get-treatments/)

### Treatment Schedules

- **Initial Series:** Most people need a series of **3 to 6 treatments** spaced about a month apart to build new collagen and see best results.[[1]](https://texasdls.com/how-often-should-you-get-a-microneedling-treatment/)[[2]](https://bodyandbeautylab.com/how-often-should-you-get-a-microneedling-treatment/)
- **Maintenance:** After finishing your initial series, touch-up or maintenance sessions are usually scheduled **every 3 to 6 months** (or 1 to 2 times a year) to preserve results.[[1]](https://www.pscatlanta.com/blog/how-often-should-you-do-microneedling/)[[2]](https://mdpen.co/blog/how-often-microneedling-schedule/)
- **Deconstructing Concerns:** Deeper issues like severe acne scars or deep wrinkles may require a longer series (up to 6 to 8 sessions), still spaced 4 to 6 weeks apart.[[1]](https://mdpen.co/blog/how-often-microneedling-schedule/)[[2]](https://theivorydentalco.com/how-often-should-you-microneedle/)

### At-Home vs. Professional Frequency

- **At-Home Devices (Shorter Needles):** Devices with 0.25 mm needles can be used every **1 to 2 weeks** mainly to help skincare products absorb. Devices with 0.5 mm needles need **2 to 4 weeks** between uses. These do not go deep enough to stimulate major collagen remodeling like professional treatments.[[1]](https://theivorydentalco.com/how-often-should-you-microneedle/)[[2]](https://mdpen.co/blog/how-often-microneedling-schedule/)
- **In-Office (Medical-Grade):** Needles penetrate deeper into the dermis (0.5 mm to 2.5 mm), requiring a strict **4-to-6-week healing window** so the skin can fully recover and rebuild collagen. Doing them too often can lead to irritation, inflammation, or scarring.[[1]](https://www.oharaderm.com/blog/how-often-can-you-microneedle-your-face)[[2]](https://mdpen.co/blog/how-often-microneedling-schedule/)[[3]](https://trailheadclinics.com/how-often-can-you-microneedle/)

If you'd like to share **what specific skin concerns** (like acne scars, fine lines, or pigmentation) you want to treat, I can give you a better idea of what a typical treatment plan looks like.
